card.name: Publisher spot in textbook citations
card.fires_on: The colon after a city and state, or the middle of a publisher name such as Lippincott or Mosby, in reference lists that cite a numbered textbook edition.

modes.label: Colon after place
modes.description: The colon after the city or state, just before the publisher name.

modes.label: Inside publisher name
modes.description: The middle of a publisher name such as Lippincott or Mosby.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; the suppressed tokens (center, centre) suggest it discourages place-style words like center after the city.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a textbook reference where the publisher name comes after the city.
